name: export-ton-verifier
description: Tool for generating Groth16 and PLONK verifier code for the TON blockchain from SnarkJS .zkey or verification key JSON files.
author: white_coon

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/index.ts src/cli.js src/generateVerifiers.js src/export_plonk_vk.js src/export_plonk_calldata.js src/export_plonk_func_calldata.js src/artifactInfo.js src/proofMessages.js src/limits.js src/templateResolver.js src/helpers.js src/utils.js src/groth16CompressProof.js --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --splitting --outdir=dist --outbase=src && tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --allowJs --checkJs false --noImplicitAny false --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --skipLibCheck --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --outDir .build-types && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('.build-types/index.d.ts','dist/index.d.ts');fs.copyFileSync('.build-types/index.d.ts','dist/index.d.cts');fs.rmSync('.build-types',{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:tolk
